# Setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tmap)

source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

raster_directory <- here::here("2-data", "rasters")
model_directory <- here::here("2-data", "models")
table_directory <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "tables")
dir.create(table_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

output_args <- "outputformat=logistic"
```

# Environmental predictors

The predictors are depth (m), dissolved oxygen (mg/L), salinity (ppt), sediment class, turbidity (NTU), and water temperature (°C). All six share the same 100 m grid. The model uses cells with values for all six predictors.

```{r}
predictor_files <- c(
  Depth = "rast_depth.tif",
  "Dissolved Oxygen" = "rast_do.tif",
  Salinity = "rast_sal.tif",
  Sediment = "rast_sed.tif",
  Turbidity = "rast_turb.tif",
  "Water Temperature" = "rast_wTemp.tif"
)
predictors <- terra::rast(file.path(raster_directory, predictor_files))
names(predictors) <- names(predictor_files)

valid_layers <- terra::app(is.finite(predictors), "sum")
complete_mask <- terra::ifel(valid_layers == terra::nlyr(predictors), 1, NA)

# Preserve the full CRS when converting to a RasterStack for dismo.
model_stack <- terra::mask(predictors, complete_mask) %>% raster::stack()
raster::crs(model_stack) <- terra::crs(predictors)
```

# Presence and background points

Keep one oyster occurrence per complete predictor cell. Sample 1,000 background points from other complete cells.

```{r}
occurrences <- readRDS(here::here("2-data", "processed", "oys_proc.rds")) %>%
  sf::st_transform(terra::crs(predictors))

occurrence_cells <- terra::cellFromXY(predictors, sf::st_coordinates(occurrences))
valid_presence <- !is.na(terra::values(complete_mask, mat = FALSE)[occurrence_cells])
presences <- occurrences[valid_presence & !duplicated(occurrence_cells), ]

set.seed(42)
background <- dismo::randomPoints(
  raster::raster(complete_mask),
  n = 1000,
  p = sf::st_coordinates(presences)
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = sf::st_crs(presences))

model_points <- rbind(
  sf::st_sf(pb = 1L, geometry = sf::st_geometry(presences)),
  sf::st_sf(pb = 0L, geometry = sf::st_geometry(background))
)
pb <- model_points$pb
point_values <- raster::extract(model_stack, sf::st_coordinates(model_points)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
stopifnot(nrow(background) == 1000L, all(is.finite(as.matrix(point_values))))
point_values$Sediment <- factor(point_values$Sediment)
```

Of the `r nrow(occurrences)` oyster records, `r sum(valid_presence)` had complete predictor values. After retaining one occurrence per cell, the model used `r nrow(presences)` presence points and `r nrow(background)` background points.

```{r}
#| label: fig-maxent-points
#| fig-cap: "Eastern oyster presence and background points used in the MaxEnt model."

study_area <- get_study_area() %>% sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(model_points))
model_points$point_type <- ifelse(pb == 1L, "Presence", "Background")

tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(complete_mask) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale(values = "grey90"), col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
  tm_shape(study_area) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey40") +
  tm_shape(model_points) +
  tm_dots(
    fill = "point_type",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = c(Background = "grey35", Presence = "red3")),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Model points"),
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```

# Spatial cross-validation

Assign 5 km spatial blocks to five folds. Hold out one fold at a time and use AUC to measure how well the model ranks held-out presences relative to background points. Omission is the proportion of held-out presences below the 10th percentile of the training presence scores.

```{r}
n_folds <- 5L
fold_id <- blockCV::cv_spatial(
  x = model_points,
  column = "pb",
  r = complete_mask,
  k = n_folds,
  size = 5000,
  presence_bg = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  plot = FALSE,
  report = FALSE,
  progress = FALSE
)$folds_ids

fold_counts <- table(factor(fold_id, levels = seq_len(n_folds)), pb)
stopifnot(
  "Each fold needs presence and background points" =
    !anyNA(fold_id) && ncol(fold_counts) == 2L && all(fold_counts > 0L)
)

fold_metrics <- vector("list", n_folds)
for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {
  test <- fold_id == fold
  train_presence <- !test & pb == 1L
  test_presence <- test & pb == 1L
  test_background <- test & pb == 0L

  fold_model <- dismo::maxent(
    x = point_values[!test, ],
    p = pb[!test],
    path = file.path(model_directory, "maxent_cv", paste0("fold_", fold))
  )
  scores <- dismo::predict(fold_model, point_values, args = output_args)
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(scores)))

  evaluation <- dismo::evaluate(p = scores[test_presence], a = scores[test_background])
  cutoff <- stats::quantile(scores[train_presence], probs = 0.10, names = FALSE)

  fold_metrics[[fold]] <- data.frame(
    fold = fold,
    training_presences = sum(train_presence),
    testing_presences = sum(test_presence),
    training_background = sum(!test & pb == 0L),
    testing_background = sum(test_background),
    test_auc = evaluation@auc,
    threshold_10pct = cutoff,
    test_omission_10pct = mean(scores[test_presence] < cutoff)
  )
}

fold_metrics <- bind_rows(fold_metrics)
metric_summary <- fold_metrics %>%
  summarise(
    folds = n(),
    mean_test_auc = mean(test_auc),
    sd_test_auc = stats::sd(test_auc),
    mean_test_omission_10pct = mean(test_omission_10pct),
    sd_test_omission_10pct = stats::sd(test_omission_10pct)
  )

readr::write_csv(fold_metrics, file.path(table_directory, "maxent_cross_validation_metrics.csv"))
readr::write_csv(metric_summary, file.path(table_directory, "maxent_cross_validation_summary.csv"))

knitr::kable(
  metric_summary,
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c("Folds", "Mean AUC", "SD of AUC", "Mean omission", "SD of omission"),
  caption = "MaxEnt spatial cross-validation results."
)
```

# Final model and habitat suitability

Fit MaxEnt using all prepared presence and background points. Map relative habitat suitability on the 0 to 1 logistic scale.

```{r}
#| label: fig-maxent-suitability
#| fig-cap: "Relative Eastern oyster habitat suitability in the Pensacola Bay System."

final_model <- dismo::maxent(
  x = point_values,
  p = pb,
  path = file.path(model_directory, "maxent_final")
)
saveRDS(final_model, file.path(model_directory, "maxent_final_model.rds"))

maxent_suitability <- dismo::predict(
  final_model,
  model_stack,
  args = output_args,
  filename = file.path(raster_directory, "maxent_suitability.tif"),
  format = "GTiff",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

tm_shape(maxent_suitability) +
  tm_raster(
    col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "viridis", limits = c(0, 1)),
    col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Relative suitability")
  ) +
  tm_shape(presences) +
  tm_dots(fill = "black", size = 0.05) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```
